component.name: Chronicle
component.summary: Native port of a PlayStation 2 action RPG, built from its decompilation

description.p: Chronicle is a decompilation of the PlayStation 2 game Dark Cloud, rebuilt from that source code as a native program that runs on Vulkan and SDL. It is not an emulator, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's developer or publisher.

No game data is included. You need your own copy of the PAL disc: the bundled dcdata tool extracts its files from a disc image into the application's data directory, and the game reads them from there. Saves are kept in the same place.
